title: The Limits of AI-Driven Allocation: Optimal Screening under Aleatoric Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2605.07979v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The rise of machine learning has shifted targeted resource allocation in policy and humanitarian settings toward algorithmic targeting based on predicted risk scores. This approach is typically cheaper and faster than traditional screening procedures that directly observe the latent vulnerability status through physical verification. Yet, even access to the true conditional vulnerability probability cannot eliminate misallocation: aleatoric uncertainty over individual vulnerability status is irreducible, and probabilistic targeting inevitably misallocates some resources. In this work, we study how screening and algorithmic targeting should be optimally combined in a two-stage allocation framework, in which a screening stage observes true outcomes for a subset of units before a final allocation stage assigns the resource under a fixed coverage budget. translated_title: AI驱动资源配置的极限：偶然不确定性下的最优甄别
translated_abstract: 机器学习的兴起使政策与人道主义领域中的定向资源配置逐渐转向基于预测风险评分的算法定向。相比通过实地核查直接观察潜在脆弱性状态的传统甄别程序，这种方法通常更廉价、更快速。然而，即使能够获得真实的条件脆弱性概率，也无法完全消除资源错配：个体脆弱性状态所固有的偶然不确定性是不可消减的，概率性定向不可避免地会错配部分资源。在本研究中，我们探讨了在一个两阶段分配框架中，甄别与算法定向应如何最优地结合。该框架包含一个甄别阶段，先对部分单元观察真实结果，随后由最终分配阶段在固定覆盖预算下进行资源分配。我们证明，最优策略是在算法分配的边际处对单元进行甄别……
tldr: 由于偶然不确定性不可消减，即使预测概率完全准确，算法定向仍会造成资源错配；最优方案是采用两阶段框架，将实地甄别集中于算法分配的边际单元，实现甄别与算法定向的最优结合。
en_tdlr: Even with perfect predicted probabilities, irreducible aleatoric uncertainty inevitably causes misallocation; the optimal two-stage policy combines physical screening with algorithmic targeting by screening units at the margin of algorithmic allocation.
